The conditional Markov entropy bound is sharp and its endpoints and intermediate frequencies are realizable. Finite diagnostics: 899 cases, but the proof establishes the infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: The source emphasizes the invariance of all periodic means, leaving the higher-moment diversity mathematically undetermined. This theorem computes the entire limiting family of stationary physical marginals, quantifies their Wasserstein convergence uniformly over all invariant laws, determines the sharp range of variance, couples it to the two-term Lyapunov law, and gives a sharp entropy envelope by symbolic frequency. These complete spectra are natural statistical invariants of the model and cannot be obtained just by a renamed first-moment equality or an isolated low-period example.
